text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
WHEAT AND BARLEY SALE - Japan bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, 40,000 of Canadian wheat, 20,000 of U.S. barley and 20,000 of Australian barley for July shipment.

WHEAT SALE - Algeria bought at least 50,000 tonnes of Canadian durum wheat for June and July shipment. Some trade sources put the volume at 75,000 tonnes. The Canadian Wheat Board declined comment on talk it sold up to 75,000 tonnes of durum wheat to Algeria for June/July shipment.
WHEAT SALE - Bulgaria bought 50,000 tonnes of wheat from Glencore in exchange for exports from the new harvest, an official at Bulgaria's government press centre said.

SOYBEAN SALE - Indications are South Korea bought 35,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans early Thursday for June shipment, said an export source. However, other exporters could not confirm the deal. No other details were available.
VEGOIL SALE - CCC bought 2,000 tonnes of U.S. sunflower seed oil for $933.65 per tonne for donation to Bosnia. Shipment was slated for June 21-July 5 and July 21- August 5, CCC said.
CORN AND SOY TENDER - Taiwan on Friday seeks 18,000 tonnes of U.S. corn and 12,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans for June delivery.
WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq seeks 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for July shipment under a United Nations oil-for-food deal. Tender offers were due on May 20.

WHEAT TENDERS - Sri Lanka seeks 100,000 tonnes HRW wheat in two lots. Tenders close on May 16. The first shipment was for May 22-June 5 if from U.S., Canada, Europe or Argentina, and June 10-19 from Australia or Saudi Arabia. The second lot was for June 16-25 if from U.S., Canada, Continent or Argentina, and June 30-July 9 from Australia or Saudi Arabia.
LENTIL TENDER - Syria offered 16,000 tonnes of lentils for export. May 20 was as the final date to receive bids and with confirmation May 21.
BARLEY TENDERS - The Cyprus Grain Commission invited tenders until May 20 for the supply of 18,000 tonnes of maize, and 25,000 tonnes of barley with a scheduled shipment in June.
- Iran will tender May 19 to import 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for shipment in August, European grain traders said.
SOYBEAN TENDERS - South Korea seeks 40,000 tonnes of No.1 soybeans. Bidding will close on May 15.

RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs issued an international tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for July shipment. June 4 was the final date to receive bids and confirmation would be made on June 12.
- The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan on Thursday invited bids by May 26 for the export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice containing seven percent broken.
RICE TENDER - Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice on May 21 for June delivery

MARKET TALK - A panamax cargo of low protein U.S. soybean meal was heard committed to a buyer in the north China province of Shandong for forward delivery in August or September, grain sources said. No details were available. ...The Philippines plans to import at least 300,000 tonnes of corn before July, Agriculture Undersecretary Joemarie Gerochi said...The European Union on Thursday granted licences to export 89,200 tonnes of free-market barley to non-EU countries at a maximum rebate of 15.90 Ecus per tonne, European grain traders said...The European Union on Thursday awarded a tariff cut of 39.25 Ecus per tonne for imports of 150,000 tonnes of maize into Portugal, the full quota set aside for that destination, European grain officials said...Japanese buyers will be picking up U.S. soybeans for July shipment this week due to firmer quotes seen on U.S. Gulf/Japan freight rates, traders said....USDA reported export sales during the week ended May 8: wheat 532,100 tonnes, corn 521,200, soybeans 141,200, soymeal 48,000, soyoil 200, upland cotton 64,800 bales, barley minus 28,600, sorghum 28,000, pima cotton 1,700 and rice 49,200 tonnes.
